in_marathi.name: Dharitri
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharitri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Dharitri is the goddess of the earth, who is often depicted as the wife of Himalaya, the god of mountains. She is the protector of all beings and is believed to provide stability and nourishment to the world.
